Use the Atlassian MCP tools (mcp__mcp-atlassian__jira_get_issue, mcp__mcp-atlassian__jira_get_transitions, jira_search etc.) to fetch the full Jira ticket SFCC-855 from the Zimmermann workboard (zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net).

I need, verbatim:
1. Full description
2. All acceptance criteria (may be in a custom field or in the description body)
3. Status, issue type, epic/parent link
4. Every comment in the comment thread, in order, with author and timestamp
5. Any linked issues (blocks/is blocked by/relates to/duplicates), and their current status
6. Any attachments referenced (Figma links, screenshots, docs)

Context for why I need this: I'm reviewing a merged PR (#77, "feat(pwa): add web app manifest and maskable icon (SFCC-855)") that claims to fix Lighthouse PWA audit failures (installable-manifest, maskable-icon, splash-screen) and explicitly flags service-worker as investigated-but-not-fixed. I need to know exactly what SFCC-855's acceptance criteria require, whether all 4 Lighthouse audits were in scope or just some, whether the ticket or its comments mention anything about the app icon artwork being placeholder/real, the CSP script-src issue, or a separate ticket for any of the follow-ups the PR author flagged. Also check if there's a linked Figma node for icon/manifest requirements.

Report back verbatim ticket content (description, ACs, comments in full — don't summarize away specifics) plus a list of any linked issues with their status. Keep your final report factual and complete rather than short — I need the actual words, not a paraphrase, since a review is being judged against the ticket's exact requirements.
